correctness.rationale: The original directed successor-only three-state map gives F^2_i=2a_i+m_i and F^3_i=2m_i+m_{i+1}, with m_i identifying 001/201 triples. Marker exclusion within distances 1 and 2 forces separated 12-pulses. On this entire image F=S; translation equivariance proves F^4=SF^3 and sharp entry cutoff three with explicit witnesses, all n>=3. The 3-state suffix transfer matrix Q(z) has characteristic polynomial lambda^3-3lambda^2+2-2z and a unique closed itinerary per cyclic word. Its z=0 roots 1,1±sqrt3 give E_n exactly and the primitive period count follows from binary gap-3 shift and Möbius inversion. Independent direct enumeration of all 3^n inputs for n=3..8 reproduced pulse histograms and trace at z=0,1,2,3 (E_3=21, E_8=3105), with witnesses at each n; inspected check_exact.py and check_direct.cpp. Finite checks corroborate but the local identities, cyclic matrix trace and Möbius argument prove the all-length statements.
